comment: Each duty's entrance circle by territory: the layout ID of the EObj retail hid with ActorControl 106 [7] at DutyCommence, whose bound object is where players come in (Bob's Chronofoil captures, read with `questkit chronofoil <captures> --layers`; tools/questkit/questkit/data/entrances.json). An EObj ID can be a circle in one duty and something else in another: 2007457 is the Porta Decumana's circle and Castrum Meridianum's way to its last hall, and Kawari took it for Castrum Meridianum's circle there until 2026-11-19 (Bob's mark: "stuck in circular barrier"), hiding the wrong object at DutyCommence. So the layout ID decides where there is one here; ENTRANCE_CIRCLE_IDS (core/src/common/game.rs) is only for duties not in the captures. `runs`: the entries each was seen in.
